headerDisplay: Controls a D-Link DSP-W215 smart plug: on/off, temperature and (in Eve) power consumption. Add one entry per plug.

host.title: Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the plug. Give it a static/reserved IP address in your router.

password.title: Device PIN
password.description: The PIN printed on the back of the plug (or the password you set in its web interface).

pollingInterval.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often the plug is queried, so changes made with its physical button show up in HomeKit.

disablePowerMeter.title: Disable power consumption
disablePowerMeter.description: Power draw is shown in Eve and used for the Home app's "in use" indicator.
